title: Great Family Trip
text: My in laws and my husband and I really enjoyed our trip to MontSerrat!  It is really beautiful.  Our tour guide was so very nice and knowledgeable.  He picked us up from two different hotels in a very nice van that was comfortable for all six of us.  The ride was very pleasant and he shared a lot about the area and its history with us on our drive to and from Montserrat.  We couldn’t have asked for a more pleasant experience thanks to Adrian!
author: Srbaudee

title: Worth the time and great guide. Highly recommend.
text: Great guide, comfortable transportation, great location. Guide very informed and attentive to our needs/interests. Liqueur tasting very fun! Beautiful location. We had time “on our own” and it was overall a very good experience!
author: Lynn_H

title: Beautiful experience.
text: This was a great tour. We took afternoon English tour. The Monastery was not crowded and our Guide Adrian  explained history and religious / cultural details in very relaxed and nice manner. He was answering all our questions with a smile. His command of English was very good. We will recommend this tour to our family and friends who may be traveling to Barcelona.
author: Tarustar

title: A day to feel blessed
